review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 28 retail bytes, 10 instructions, 1 block, 0 edges; candidate 1/0 at CFG 1.000.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Two cdecl arguments read from [esp+4] (head) and [esp+8] (node); neither is modified in place by the call, the registers are scratch.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Offsets +0x00, +0x04 and +0x08 only; no scale, mask or arithmetic.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Four pointer reads and four pointer stores, all within the two objects passed in - no global is touched, so no storage ownership question arises.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call. Side effects are the four stores in retail's order: node back pointer, node forward pointer, previous tail's forward pointer, head tail pointer.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry, one exit: the ret at +0x1B. No branch, no early return and no error path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Pointer arithmetic only; no floating-point register is touched.

runtime_contract.scope: paired retail/candidate observation of the four stores during level-1 startup

limitations: Runtime not yet paired: the candidate exits at 0x00402930 before any game native runs.
The node type beyond its first two pointer fields is not established; the list layout is inferred jointly from this body and 0x004F1D60 and stated as such.
